notes: Kept: the staggered pair (the back capsule appears only as its top arc between the front capsule and the tag, hidden elsewhere), both capsules hollow, the seam square to the capsule axis and slightly left of centre, the tag's filled black hole, and the dollar sign's bars above and below the S. Red follows the red sheet: the seam is red only from 5.2 px above the capsule axis down to the lower side, and black above that; the change is a square cut. The catalogue calls it 'the short dividing seam', which matches that red part. The red seam stops at the inner edge of the black lower side, which lies over it, as on the red sheet. The tag outline and dollar sign are red; the hole is black and sits over the top of the dollar bar; the back capsule's arc is black and passes over the red tag corner. This is one of the eight icons with low sheet-to-sheet agreement; the difference is the red sheet's thinner strokes.
